programme.title: Las Islas Canarias
programme.desc: El viento y el agua transportaron semillas, insectos y animales pioneros a las islas aisladas.

programme.title: El Caribe Salvaje - Los ritmos de la vida
programme.desc: Las costas e islas coralinas del Caribe, formadas por criaturas vivas y por restos de criaturas que alguna vez estuvieron vivas, son ahora un laberinto de vida. Cada año, en un asombroso despliegue sincronizado de desove de coral, los "animales flor" recolonizan los arrecifes.

programme.title: América Salvaje
programme.desc: En el norte de Sudamérica existe un enorme territorio de llanuras interminables que cambia su aspecto dos veces al año: a veces inundado aparentemente hasta el infinito, otras casi desecado.

programme.title: Mundos de Agua
programme.desc: Tras muchos kilómetros recorridos, el río cambia el paisaje. En sus meandros abandonados se multiplican las especies.

programme.title: Mundos de Agua
programme.desc: Son los grandes almacenes de la naturaleza. La base de todo son las pequeñas algas, dieta de numerosos moluscos, insectos, crustáceos y peces.

programme.title: Planeta Selva
programme.desc: En el Estado de California crecen algunos de los bosques más notables del planeta por su magnitud, su diversidad y por la dimensión gigantesca de sus árboles.

programme.title: Planeta Selva
programme.desc: Uno de los ecosistemas más raros del planeta es el Bosque Espinoso de Madagascar donde casi todas las plantas cuentas con espinas como puñales.

programme.title: Siyaya - Bienvenidos a la Naturaleza
programme.desc: El autobús cebra se embarca en una misión final para encontrar al último miembro de los 7 grandes, el gran tiburón blanco, que partieron hacia la isla de los pájaros para observar nidos y pájaros recién nacidos.

programme.title: Siyaya - Bienvenidos a la Naturaleza
programme.desc: En este episodio, los niños aprenden la verdad sobre la historia de su khoisan. De vuelta en el autobús cebra, la tensión aumenta cuando la carretera está bloqueada, mis elefantes y pronto quedan atrapados por una manada.

programme.title: Mississippi
programme.desc: Un viaje desde el origen del Misisipi a través de la naturaleza y la diversidad.

programme.desc: Dos grandes aves acuáticas están experimentando un verdadero auge demográfico que parece imparable.

programme.title: El Arte de La Naturaleza

programme.title: Austria salvaje: la fuerza del agua

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Viajamos con Lety Zetune, experta en experiencias de lujo y agente de viajes de NUBA, nominada como una de las mejores agencias de México. Con ella, descubrimos por qué viajar no solo es una forma de conocer el mundo, sino también de reconectar contigo mismo.Desde los mejores destinos para una despedida de soltera, hasta los rincones más exóticos para una luna de miel, Lety nos guía a través de los secretos de planear un viaje inolvidable. En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

En una charla cercana y divertida con nuestros conductores, derriba mitos sobre aerolíneas low cost, comparte tips para realizar presupuestos, revela sus destinos favoritos en México y nos cuenta cómo convirtió un viaje familiar en una búsqueda del tesoro en Machu Picchu.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: La talentosa actriz Majo Pérez nos abre las puertas de su mundo artístico y emocional. Majo relata cómo descubrió su pasión por la actuación, sus inicios en los escenarios y cómo el teatro se convirtió en su refugio. A lo largo de la entrevista, Majo reflexiona sobre los nervios que nunca desaparecen antes de salir a escena, los desafíos de interpretar personajes complejos, como su inolvidable papel de Sally Bowles en "Cabaret", y las experiencias incómodas que pueden surgir frente al público. Con sensibilidad, honestidad y carisma, Majo revela cómo ha roto moldes al interpretar roles tradicionalmente masculinos y cómo el escenario le ha permitido conocerse profundamente. Una conversación íntima y poderosa con una actriz que sigue desafiando los límites de la interpretación.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Nos acompaña Clara Corona de Lau, consultora en cultura organizacional, fundadora de Think Lynk y pionera en transformar la forma en que vivimos nuestro espacio laboral. Reconocida por múltiples presidentes de México y galardonada con el Premio Nacional del Empresario, Clara nos comparte su visión sobre liderazgo, bienestar y propósito dentro del entorno laboral. - Descubrimos los pilares que hacen de una empresa un lugar extraordinario: confianza, valores, empatía y una cultura sólida. También exploramos la historia de su reconocida empresa “Biomédica de Referencia”, ejemplo de excelencia y humanidad. - Un episodio inspirador que revela cómo la cultura organizacional no es un lujo, sino el corazón mismo del éxito.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: El reconocido director Chava Espinosa, nos revela los secretos detrás de la dirección de series y películas que han marcado tendencia en la televisión y el streaming. Con una trayectoria que inició desde el catering hasta llegar a la dirección de producciones icónicas como "Club de Cuervos", Chava comparte su evolución profesional con honestidad y buen humor. El episodio ofrece una mirada privilegiada al proceso creativo del director: desde el manejo de actores, el arte de construir comedia, hasta la presión de las premieres y el impacto del público en el resultado final. Además, reflexiona sobre el futuro del cine independiente, los cambios de la industria tras la pandemia y sus deseos de incursionar en géneros como la acción, el terror y la ciencia ficción. Una conversación dinámica, divertida e inspiradora con uno de los nombres clave en la nueva generación de directores en Latinoamérica.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. - Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: La actriz, productora y activista social Vanessa Bauche nos acompaña para compartir su inspiradora trayectoria artística y personal. Vanessa rememora su autodeterminación desde temprana edad y sus primeros acercamientos al arte y la actuación. A lo largo del programa, reflexiona sobre los prejuicios en la industria, la importancia del teatro, y su activismo social. Desde su icónica participación en “Amores Perros” hasta su reconocimiento internacional, Vanessa habla de su vocación, sus desafíos y aprendizajes. Así como la importancia de la salud mental, la autoaceptación y su filosofía de vida: “La mujer que se tiene a sí misma nunca está sola”. Un recorrido íntimo por la carrera y visión de una de las actrices más reconocidas de México, galardonada con múltiples premios Ariel y aclamada tanto en cine como en teatro.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.desc: Recibimos al irreverente y entrañable Mauricio Barrientos “Diablito”, actor, conductor, comediante y figura clave del entretenimiento en México. Entre risas, anécdotas y reflexiones honestas, Diablito nos muestra su lado más humano y auténtico, más allá del personaje que todos conocemos. Desde sus inicios en TV Azteca, hasta su participación en telenovelas, reality shows y programas de comedia, exploramos cómo ha evolucionado su carrera y su voz como artista. Un episodio entre la carcajada y la introspección, con un invitado que ha logrado mantenerse vigente rompiendo esquemas, sin perder su esencia.

programme.desc: Los lagos, ríos y marismas que laten a través de las Montañas Rocosas sustentan una asombrosa diversidad de vida. Desde los picos inhóspitos hasta los deltas oceánicos repletos, descubre cómo el agua es la clave para mantener todos los aspectos de la vida en la montaña próspera.

programme.title: Rocheuses sauvages
programme.desc: La mezcla de bosques antiguos y nuevos en las Montañas Rocosas crea un equilibrio que permite que cada especie prospere. Aprenda cómo tanto la Madre Naturaleza como los humanos protegen esta mezcla esencial de bosques, incluso si eso significa destruirlos de vez en cuando.

programme.title: Rocheuses sauvages
programme.desc: La vida en grupo es parte integral de muchos de los animales que viven en las Montañas Rocosas. programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 13: on December 21, 2013 at the Ariake Coliseum in Tokyo, Japan. The highlight of the event was a Glory Welterweight World Championship Tournament. Two tournament matches were held, with a third match as reserve. The winners of the two semi-final bouts proceeded to the finals for the championship main-event. The event also featured other non-tournament bouts, including the retirement match of the legendary Peter Aerts, against Rico Verhoeven, and Daniel Ghiță vs. Errol Zimmerman II.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In Istanbul, the best Light Heavyweight will be determined as Tyrone Spong vs. Saulo Cavalari and Gokhan Saki vs. Nathan Corbett start off the 4-Man Championship Tournament. Also, Robin van Roosmalen faces Marat Grigorian in the main event. Van Roosmalen tries to get back to his winning ways after suffering a tough K.O. in his last fight.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: This event featured Glory Light Heavyweight World Championship Tournament for the inaugural Glory Light Heavyweight Championship. Two bouts was held as semi-finals. The winners of the semi-finals proceeded to the final bout for the tournament championship. This event also featured other non-tournament one-off bouts, the two headlines.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: This event featured world title fight for the inaugural Glory Welterweight Championship of Karapet Karapetyan vs. Marc de Bonte as headliner, and 4 Man Heavyweight Contender Tournament.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY 16 slams into Denver with the Welterweight World Title fight, the Heavyweight Contender Tournament, and the debut of USA Martial Arts sensation Pat Barry. Belgian striker Marc de Bonte will battle Armenia's technical machine Karapet Karapetyan for the vacant GLORY Welterweight World Title, guaranteeing a fast, explosive war. At the heaviest end of the GLORY ranks, the big-boys are set to battle it out for a higher ranked spot in the Heavyweight division, and a chance to fight for the Title later within the year. The lineup pits Errol "The Bonecrusher" Zimmerman versus "Bangin" Ben Edwards in a semi-final, and Sergei "The Paratrooper" Kharitonov vs. Anderson "Braddock" Silva in another semi-final. The tournament winner will have to win two fights in one night to claim the prize, and the right to fight for a bigger prize later in the year. Also at Heavyweight, in a tournament reserve match, MMA veteran Pat "HD" Barry returns to his original love of kickboxing, facing another GLORY debutant in the shape of Zack "The Black Warrior" Mwekassa.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: On the preliminary card, a 4-Man Featherweight Contender Tournament and other one-off bouts were featured.Mirko Cro Cop was first scheduled to face Pat Barry, and later Sergei Kharitonov on this card. However, on May 21, it was announced that Kharitonov had to withdraw from the fight due to injury. He was replaced by Jarrell Miller.Miguel Torres was scheduled to make his GLORY debut as a participant of the Featherweight tournament. However, on May 28, it was revealed he pulled out of the tournament for undisclosed reasons. He was replaced by Marcus Vinicius.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the World Finals of the Strongman Champions League tour 2023 at the Sarajevo Centar Skenderija in Bosnia. 3 Events was done already and amazing results have been set. Who will be the new World champion? Find out here, who, after 16 stages, will be crowned World Champion 2023.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 10 years there is another edition of THE ICEMAN in minus 25 degrees and snow, and it is also the first stage in the MLO Strongman Champions League. With a new World champion from South Africa, Rayno Nel, it will be a challenging year for all the athletes to win the title again after 1 full year. But now they can win one very exceptional title, which is the SCL ICEMAN!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Hungary this year is in the AQUAPARK in Budapest, Stage 3 from the spectacular MLO Strongman Champions League, World is Biggest Pro League. With five great events, such as: Viking Press, Farmer's Walk, Deadlift, Conan's Wheel, and A loading race with Beer barrels of 200 Kg. It is a must see!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Zrenjanin, Serbia, again a fantastic stage in the SCL WORLD SERIES TOUR 2024, five events including a super human Yoke race. Who will be the yellow leader for the coming season and take the title with 25 championship points?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in Groenlo, east of Holland With the new Talent from South Africa and 2025 Strongest Man of the World - Rayno Nel. The first 3 events are Truckpull, Log Lift and Loading race. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it is the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it is about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland , continues with the last 3 events, here at the venue in Groenlo. The events in this episode are the Conan Wheel, Farmers Walk and the Atlas Stones, with a brutal 200kg stone at the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League: World Record Breakers 2024 kicks off with the Truck Pull, followed by the Front Hold, Frame Carry, Tractor Pull, Shield Carry, Sandbag Toss, and concludes with the intense Loading Race. This two-day competition features all the top strongmen from Finland-and it's one for the history books. Three new world records are shattered, making this a must-see episode for...

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in over 10 years back in Estonia, in Tartu. 12 of the Strongest athletes in the world will fight here for the title and the overall world championship points. You will see 5 crazy events, such as: Boat Pull, Viking Press, Medley, Conan's Wheel and a very heavy Power Stairs!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to Portugal, at the beach of Eposende, to bring you EUROPE'S STRONGEST LATINO. In the beautiful sun of Portugal five cruel events are done in this heat: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Log Lift, Sandbag Toss, Medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A spectacular event on the beach of Gdansk, Poland. A competition in the sand and in the water. Complete with a boat pull. With an impressive line up again, we welcome you to watch us LIVE in the SCL Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League Train stops in Dubai again for the 3rd time, and is now bigger than ever. Hafthor Bjornsson makes his come back here at the SCL DUBAI. You simply cannot miss this most epic show at the World Trade Center in Dubai part 1.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League kicks off its 2014 season in Martinique.

programme.desc: The second stage of 2014 Strongman champions League, in Cologne, Germany. 14 athletes from 12 different countries battled through six events on the second stop

Dae-in dies on the scene and Wu-song leaves the killer's name on the cave wall before he dies. Dae-in's son Wang Gak thinks Wu-Song killed his father and fights with his son Jung-pa. Trader Kwan and her daughter Mi-ryung stop the fight. Jung-pa and Mi-ryung's love is disturbed by Ju-yang. Gak and Jung-pa chase him to find Wu-song's body with Ju-yang's name on the wall but Mi-ryung appeals them not to kill...

programme.title: The Trouble With Spies
programme.desc: George Trent, a British spy, has gone incommunicado in Ibiza. Appleton Porter (Donald Sutherland) is sent to find out what happened to Trent. Porter settles into a small hotel with several busybody guests. He probes them for information about Trent, their former neighbor. Meanwhile, the spy survives several attempts on his life as he attempts to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Tonight, Atlanta is the site of hard-driving freestyle! This is Monster Jam from the Georgia Dome in Atlanta, GA during Monster Jam's 2001 season.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Stadium Championship Series East returns to the dome as Tyler Menninga attempts to lead Grave Digger to back-to-back event championships. Tom Meents wants to double down in freestyle and Tristan England looking for a win for his new JCB Digatron.

programme.title: Monster Jam Fast Track
programme.desc: Monster Jam Fast Track ignites the competition in Syracuse with thrilling racing and stunts. Rivalries heat up as drivers navigate intense head-to-head races. Spectacular jumps and high-speed crashes keep fans on the edge of their seats. The Halloween theme adds excitement to the spectacle. Expect the unexpected in this adrenaline-fueled event.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Feel the roar of the engines in Las Vegas as the World Finals reach a fever pitch during an unforgettable freestyle session. Dennis Anderson sets a punishing pace, driving on the "ragged edge" with relentless intensity , while Todd LeDuc risks it all in Metal Militia with massive air and back-to-back backflips. From the high-stakes pressure of "bonus time" maneuvers to the incredible "wow factor" of four-second hang times, this competition demonstrates exactly what championships are made of.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Monster Jam’s 2020 season continues in the Dunkin Donuts Center in Providence, RI.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: It's time for freestyle carnage! This week, St. Louis is in for one wild ride from the Trans World Dome during the 2001 season of Monster Jam!

programme.title: Arena Series in 30
programme.desc: Monster Jam's Arena in 30 makes it's next stop in Rosemont, IL with more racing and freestyle fun.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Monster Jam's trucks and drivers continue with freestyle action from Raymond James Stadium, on February 6, 2010.

programme.title: Primetime
programme.desc: Monster Jam in East Rutherford with racing, skills, and freestyle that the whole family will enjoy!

programme.desc: Monster Jam races into the Orlando Citrus Bowl, on January 29, 2011.

programme.title: Primetime

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Monster Jam races into the Citrus Bowl with star-studded racing action from Orlando, FL, on January 26, 2008.

programme.title: Primetime
programme.desc: Racing, skills, and freestyle action are in store during Monster Jam's stop in San Diego, CA.

programme.title: Stadium Championship Series
programme.desc: Experience the 2025 Monster Jam in Arlington, Texas — where top drivers and roaring fans come together for the ultimate dirt-fueled championship battle.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: The superstars of Monster Jam invade Chase Field in the great American southwest of Phoenix, AZ with exciting racing action on January 27, 2007.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: What better way to celebrate Unicorn Day than with Monster Jam's very own Sparkle Smash?! Check out Sparkle Smash and the best 2024 and 2025 freestyles, two-wheel skills, sky wheelies, races, and donuts from our favorite unicorn on wheels.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Don't miss all the racing action from the Mercedes-Benz Superdome, on January 28, 2012.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: All the Monster Jam triple threat action from the Sprint Center on January 18, 2020!

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Don't miss the thrills and excitement of racing action from Raymond James Stadium, on February 6, 2010.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Celebrate 25 years of "The Crazy Bull" with a high-octane compilation of El Toro Loco’s most legendary moments. This episode captures the sheer intensity of Freestyle competitions as fan-favorite drivers like Lucas Souza and Mark MacDonald push their machines to the ragged edge to chase down rivals like Bounty Hunter. Witness heart-stopping "wow moments," including near-backflips, massive saves, and a dramatic "spin cycle" donut that leaves the track smoking. From mechanical failures like broken drive shafts to the pure adrenaline of bonus time, see why this 12,000-pound beast remains a world-class force in the stadium.

programme.title: World Finals
programme.desc: Don't miss all the racing thrills and excitement from the Monster Jam World Finals 11 on March 27, 2010.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Monster Jam races into M&T Bank Stadium, on June 2, 2012 with all your favorite trucks and drivers!

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: High-octane Monster Jam racing takes center stage as fierce competitors battle for supremacy. Expect nail-biting moments, intense rivalries, and heart-pounding action in Charlotte. Will Triton Robbins maintain his lead or will Krysten Anderson or Armando Castro dethrone him? Spectacular jumps and near crashes heighten the stakes in this adrenaline-fueled event.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Monster Jam's 2012 season - epic racing action from the Georgia Dome on January 14, 2012.

programme.title: Arena in 25
programme.desc: Monster Jam's 2022 season continues at Golden 1 Credit Union Center in Sacramento, CA featuring racing, 2-wheel, donuts, and freestyle competitions.

programme.title: Championship Series
programme.desc: Stadium Championship Series East rides into the racing capital of the world. The newly formed Monster Jam rivalry heats up between Grave Digger’s Tyler Menninga and JCB Diagtron’s Tristan England as they battle for the series points lead. Meanwhile, Tom Meents looks to lead Max D to victory in one of the wildest freestyle competitions of the season.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, host Jameson Redding takes guests Jesse Laspeyre and Brooks Beatty on a multi-day adventure exploring the Forgotten Coast along the Florida Adventure Trail, chasing fish and adventure at every turn.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: Experience the magic of shore diving from one of the Keys’ most scenic beaches. The episode also follows military veterans discovering healing and renewed purpose through diving.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: New. York. City. That’s where our host Josh Rosen kicks off his journey in Episode 4—and where he lived for 16 years and started up the surf-centric apparel brand, Saturdays NYC. Back in his old stomping grounds, Josh first meets up with the award-winning chef and Mumbai native, Chintan Pandya, currently blowing up the New York food scene with his unapologetic and authentic Indian cuisine (pro tip: try the goat brains). Next, Josh travels through the boroughs, heads upstate, and along the coast to source local ingredients—from sake brewers and pig farmers to catching fresh lobster just 100 miles from Wall Street. As always the adventure will end with a feast, right back in Chintan’s kitchen.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: In this episode, we will highlight what’s being done in the Florida Keys to protect and save the reefs. We will show innovative solutions researchers have created to protect the coral and showcase the recovery that’s taking place.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael continues the family tradition of fish stew and gathering, with hopes that Larkin will pass on the same traditions.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: As the pressure of opening his new store builds, Josh steps away from the chaos and returns to the water for a solo wade fishing trip — his first in years.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: With few mature bucks to hunt Dean heads out to put his time in regardless because anything, can happen.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Deep in the backroads of the Midwest there are stories locals rarely tell out loud. Stories of pale figures with oversized heads watching from the trees. Stories passed down in whispers and warnings. The Melon Heads legend has haunted Michigan, Ohio, and surrounding states for decades. Some say they are the result of dark experiments. Others believe they are something far older. Something that never left the woods.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff hear about the dangers of fishing for Bluefin Tuna in the Atlantic Ocean from locals in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Then they head 30 miles out onto the open ocean with Darrin of Reel Respect Charters in the hopes of landing their own giant.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff team up with their friends from Boss Shotshells in South Dakota for a high-energy upland hunt, pursuing wild pheasants with the help of skilled hunting dogs. The adventure takes a quirky turn with a visit to the iconic Corn Palace.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: After harvesting a tough Anatolian Chamois, Mark Peterson heads south to the Taurus Mountains for his next challenge: The Bezoar Ibex. With the pre-rut in full swing, most Ibex are in small bachelor groups. It's only a matter of time before Mark spots a mature trophy—requiring skill, patience, and a solid understanding of this rugged terrain.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson returns to the stunning island of Dugi Otok in Croatia for his third time in pursuit of a Kri Kri ibex. This Mediterranean gem offers a true sportsman's paradise, home to an incredible variety of huntable species. While the island presents opportunities for Axis Deer and other game—which Mark briefly glasses during his adventure—the primary focus remains on connecting with a quality Kri Kri Ibex. Join Mark as he navigates the familiar yet ever-challenging terrain of Dugi Otok.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along with Mark Peterson as he heads north to Nunavut within the Arctic Circle. On this trip, he has brought along his Gunwerks muzzleloader as well as his Gunwerks rifle. With two Caribou tags and a Musk Ox tag in his pocket, he’s excited to put both firearms to use. The muzzleloader is up to bat first. With the rocky, wide open tundra terrain it makes it more of a challenge to get close enough with the muzzleloader.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This week is all about Woody, a fearless Jack Russle who spends his free time doing everything from Black Bear hunting in Vancouver to Sheep hunting in the mountains.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson has one more tag in his pocket after harvesting both a Central Barren Ground Caribou and a Muskox with his Gunwerks muzzleloader on day one. This time, he has his Gunwerks rifle in hand. The conditions have been perfect, but there is a front pushing in with a ton of rain coming so Mark is eager to fill his final tag before the bad weather hits. Spotting a large group of Caribou with one big one mixed in early on in the day, he is hoping to have success and end his trip to Nunavut off with a bang!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: In this episode, we're headed out to Oklahoma to follow along with the Sharp brothers as they hunt whitetails in their home state. You never know what to expect with these two but one thing you can always rely on is that they always have some big deer to go after!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode we travel to Rock Falls Raceway in Wisconsin to highlight our nations heroes who have made drag racing and serving our country a way of life! We also honor our next Fargo Scheels Hometown hero, Elizabeth Miller.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel north of the border for an unforgettable PART 1 Canadian fly-in fishing trip with Mandatory Fun Outdoors. We also highlight our next Scheels Hometown Hero, Jay Strande!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Don Weber recounts his amazing journey through survivors guilt, PTSD and starting over.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Carlos Powell tells of family sacrifice and fighting his post service “demons.”

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: It's the second day of the Alabama Turkey season, and we hit the woods with Dr. Mike Chamberlain and Aaron Warbritton from The Hunting Public in search of a longbeard. Watching turkeys just being turkeys, and spending time with great friends is why turkey hunting is just different to us.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This one is special. We took Ron aka “Don”, a WoodHaven employee who helps assemble our pot calls, out to Tennessee for a turkey hunt he’ll never forget. After 35 years of not harvesting a Turkey, Don finally gets his shot.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Some mornings just remind you why we do this. We found ourselves in Southwest Alabama on one of the prettiest mornings a turkey hunter could ever ask for — cool air, soft light breaking through the timber, and gobbles echoing through the hardwoods. Even better, we got to share it with a great friend, and that’s what makes hunts like this truly special. This is what turkey hunting is all about — good friends, beautiful mornings, and chasing longbeards in God’s country.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This Kentucky trip is one we’ll be talking about for a long time. Three longbeards hit the ground, but honestly, it’s the time spent in the woods with good friends that made this hunt what it was. We had birds gobbling, lots of laughs, and a memories that will last a lifetime, and that’s what makes turkey hunting so addicting. These are the kind of hunts you don’t take for granted.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Anderson and Capt. Ryan Rickard keep track of the catch during an epic day in Steinhatchee, FL.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Part 2 of this friendly competition picks right back up where things left off in Steinhatchee, FL with Capt. Mike Anderson and Capt. Ryan Rickard.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Josh and George from Two Georges Marina battle the wind and tide on a tough day of fishing which leads Josh to fish another day, solely for revenge on the Sheepshead!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Join Captain Josh and Sheriff Eric Aden for a day of fishing and fun in Destin, Florida. These two friends hit the water, catching fish both offshore and inshore, and reeling in some impressive catches. With plenty of laughs, great stories, and a few surprises along the way, this episode is all about the joy of fishing and the bond between two guys who love the sea.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Capt. CA looks back on 20 years of Flats Class TV and picks some of his favorite moments to revisit.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA’s skiff gets an upgrade. Now no fish is safe.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Low country BBQ and Redfish? What more do you want?

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA heads to the scenic Low country of South Carolina for part one of an epic two-part redfish adventure.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting. From the pressure of national competition to the routines that build confidence, they reveal how preparation, mental focus, and years of dedication lead to success. The transcript emphasizes that managing pressure is a learned skill, supported by consistent routines and trust in dependable equipment like Winchester AA shotshells. - As the two champions train, mentor the next generation, and reflect on the journeys that shaped their careers, the episode celebrates more than trophies. With Kim's Olympic legacy and Desi's Hall of Fame induction, the passion, perseverance, and commitment to excellence that continue to inspire shooters across the country.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi day deer camp. Along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau. Chris and Casey are on the search for some large bucks, as well as showing the people at the camp a great time and what deer season is all about.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Mike Avinon takes Blair off Naples for a variety of fish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor
programme.desc: Capt. Blair tries for an upgrade off the coast of Naples.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: For Mike Pentecost and his son Jacob, Illinois deer camp has become a tradition they look forward to every single year. It’s a place filled with memories, time spent together, and a shared love for chasing whitetails.But this trip carries a little more meaning. At 17 years old, Jacob is heading into his final year of being eligible for Illinois’ special youth season and he and Mike are hoping to make one last trip to deer camp count.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.
These hunters know the key to taking giant whitetails consistently is all about being in the right place at the right time. Brady Snyder hunts down a giant 200″ buck in Iowa from 2023.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: For decades, Paul Butski has set the standard in turkey calling. His name is etched into the NWTF Grand National Calling Championships Hall of Fame, and his influence stretches far beyond the stage. He didn’t just win competitions, he shaped the way we talk to turkeys – and more importantly, the way we hunt them.
If you hunt big whitetails this is a must see! Follow Adam Hays and Lee Lakosky as they hunt for multiple giants and learn some tactics for harvesting monster whitetails!

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin and Florida WaterSports pro Jeff Lange go deep off Panama City Beach to test the limits of a new battery powered reel. The results are surprising.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience

programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head offshore to the Marathon Hump, taking advantage of the 26-feet hybrid boat's versatility to find some exciting Blackfin and Skipjack Tuna fishing.

programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by scientist Nick Haddad, who educates our hosts and the fishing world on the various descending devices used to preserve stressed catch from deeper waters as the three of them get into some fun Red Snapper fishing off the coast of Marathon, Florida in the Keys.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Rich's son Reed, who takes the wheel and directs the team into some amazing early morning baby tarpon fishing in the Everglades.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor take Hunter Smallback into the Everglades for some snook fishing, and the action really heats up when some hungry Lemon sharks crash the party.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience

programme.title: Hooked on The Palm Beaches

programme.title: West End Boatworks
programme.desc: Chris, Billy, and Capt. Austin Oskey take on Boca Grande for a day of tarpon fishing, putting in the time on the water while chasing some of the area’s hard-fighting fish. After a full day on the boat, they wrap up the trip with a well-earned plate of chicken wings.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are still at the Raven in Missouri trying to finish planting 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days. Then Randy heads to the Powder River in Montana and tries to knock down his first buck of the 2025 season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: Randy is getting the last food plot of the season in down at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma. Then opening day of the 2025 bow season starts off in an unusual way for the crew. Randy smokes a Hog and Nate Has a really close call with one of the target bucks.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Explore the fascinating history of exotic species in Texas, tracking how non-native wildlife populations have transformed the Lone Star landscape from early 20th-century introductions to today. programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting

From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Rex meets up with “Mr Crappie” Wally Marshall in Texas. Wally takes Rex to one of his secret spots to put the hammer on the crappie. Not only did they catch crappie, but nice largemouth and some top tier coppernose bluegill.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Crew heads to Rivers Lodge and Hunt Club in Kansas to fish strip pits. Trenton and Rex take on Mike and Nate in a 3 period mini tournament. With multiple species allowed including northern pike, the two teams are neck and neck after the first two periods. Due to bad weather on day 2, period 3 turned into a hour speed round where only keeper largemouth count.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.
